extraction.coordinateUnits: PDF points; page is 1-based, column 0 left/1 right

review.method: explicit candidate classification and column/paragraph boundary audit; related tables/sidebars assigned separately

limitations: SRD5.1 only; not full PHB or other books.
Russian names are project translations; original English prose is preserved.
Class setup/progression and general race/feat introductions remain in the source corpus; they are not selectable entries.
Tables retain source text/row order; no automatic execution of effects.
Level is null unless the opening text explicitly states its level; actionType is not inferred.
